prose: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available to everyone: developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers. Google calls it its strongest model, with frontier cybersecurity capability and long-horizon agentic work across knowledge work, software engineering and scientific reasoning. Two weeks earlier it went to cybersecurity defenders through the Fairwind Program. Gemini 4 Argon remains the default choice for most engineering and knowledge work.
highlights: Frontier claims in cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic work
Earlier limited release to cyber defenders
